title: E5 + P3 + Idea 1 (motion attribution): pre-registration, core
written: 2026-10-21 (IST), before any test-split or transfer-split result of U2, U4, U5
decisions_approved_by_user: factorial set as rendered (native bpy 4.3 port; D re-renders match the 4090 data: v2 98/98 GT motions equal, median-flow within 0.01 px in 95/98, max 0.18 px)
OpenD4RT: 32CLIP checkpoint, 24-frame clips padded to 32 by repeating the last frame (pad_to_clip=True); world readouts r3 (s_w) and r4 primary, camera-frame r1 and r2 secondary
TrackCraft3R: stretch resize mode, no t0 re-registration, primary; conditions (i) GT depth+cameras and (ii) DA3 primary, (iii) identity cameras exploratory
X2 (U3) paused by the user on 2026-10-20; its test T3' is removed from the confirmatory family; X2 may later be reported as framing only
lead decision: all-view object screen (objall; B and D share the camera path, so all views are pixel-aligned) is the primary object screen and the H3 test; the view-0 object screen is secondary

excluded_scenes.reason: generator could not place the moving body (same scenes unusable on the 4090)

splits.test: v2 odd seeds (48 usable base scenes)

real.posesets: Sintel 14-sequence MonST3R subset, TUM-dynamics first 90 frames stride 3, Bonn MonST3R protocol; windows of 8 consecutive evaluation frames, Sim(3) alignment per window

metrics: unified plan section 6 (alpha, beta with identifiability filter cond<=10 and median |A|,|B|>=2 px; s_w through-origin slope after per-scene median-depth scale alignment; static residual; ATE Sim3, RPE-T, RPE-R as RMSE over consecutive views; spurious ego-motion; tau, lambda, kappa; completeness)
boundary_rule: exclude points within 8 px (at 512) of moving-object boundaries; primary = with exclusion; also reported without

statistics.correction: Holm over the confirmatory family below, alpha = 0.05

confirmatory_family.T1a: OpenD4RT r3 world-frame slope s_w < 0.9; one-sided scene bootstrap on v2 test + v3float transfer
confirmatory_family.T1_validity: lifted CoTracker3 and lifted RAFT must give s_w >= 0.9 for T1 to be read
confirmatory_family.T5p: U5a object-gain edit (i) A-direction orthogonal to B, g = 1.5 primary (g = 2 secondary) vs 20 random 2D projectors of matched norm: alpha change, one-sided, paired over test scenes
confirmatory_family.T7: factorial interaction I = alpha_D - alpha_C for Any4D on test scenes identifiable in D, two-sided paired scene bootstrap; |I| >= 0.10 effect (negative I supports account K), |I| < 0.05 with CI including 0 = no interaction (supports account R), otherwise inconclusive; repeated with s_w (descriptive)
confirmatory_family.T8: contamination dRPE-R(D - B) > 0 for Any4D, one-sided paired bootstrap over test scenes; VGGT descriptive
confirmatory_family.T9: H1 double dissociation at k*: P_obj (objall top-k*) tau_O and P_cam (cam top-k*) tau_C both above the 95th percentile of 40 matched random nulls and both leakages <= 0.2; p = max of the two null ranks
confirmatory_family.T10: U5b contamination masking (a) internal-probe mask in top-k* contamination heads vs (c) k* random heads (20 draws, matched block distribution): real pose-set RPE-R, one-sided, paired over windows

success_rules.U5a: (i) alpha +0.10 or more, beta change <= 0.03, moving EPE change <= +1 px, static EPE <= +5%; and (ii) B-direction edit moves beta >= 0.10 with alpha change <= 0.03
success_rules.U5b: (a) beats (c) (T10), reaches >= 50% of the oracle GT-mask-all-heads improvement (d), moving EPE change <= +1 px; if Any4D contamination CI includes 0 on Kubric and real data, U5b is reported as null and moves to VGGT (descriptive)
success_rules.T9_k: k* = smallest k in {1,3,5,10,20} reaching 80% completeness on FIT scenes, per screen

fit_derived_values: TO BE APPENDED by the mechanism run before any test-split run: k* per screen, top-k* head lists, motion-probe layer L* and its 90%-recall threshold, U5a projector files, U5b head list; each with sha256 and a frozen_at timestamp. No test-split or transfer-split mechanism result may be computed before this block exists.
